maturity.title: Five levels of a digital twin, and where these examples stand

levels: Descriptive
A live, editable model of the asset, in its place
IFC models on the real terrain of Barcelona
Informative
Operational and sensor data on the model
Bike docks, bus bays and stations coloured by live open data
Predictive
Insights and forecasts from the data collected
Readings are recorded as trends, not forecast
Comprehensive

Sun and shadow studies, rain-flood simulation
Autonomous

On purpose: a public demo should not switch anything
